title: got online multiplayer working in my weird cat game!!
author: GTTGgames
selftext:
Made this weird little cat fighting game over the weekend and now it's kinda an obsession? But made two big updates in the patch just now. Name change! Cat Game 6 is now

https://preview.redd.it/ydpsx6pnuteh1.png?width=2622&format=png&auto=webp&s=4aded5c5ddb2f786c2c80c1e2f9ef566b190cd12

And got online multiplayer WORKING. As some of you know that can be tricky! I learned alot too while working with opus on netcode and latency and host 'owning' certain aspects of the game. The back and forth with making the friend codes shorter (originally, they were like a paragraph or two of letters and numbers ha.

So yeah, this little project is something I might update more and package up for Steam.

Right now, you can play it [itch.io](http://itch.io)

comments.author: Acceptable_Movie6712
comments.body: What’s the multiplayer backend? I’ve had really good success using steam’s multiplayer API and backend for lobbies but curious what else people are using.

replies.author: GTTGgames
replies.body: we used netcode and I made a server via wrangler .. its a lot ha. I can find some of the backend chat we were haing

replies.author: GTTGgames
replies.body: using a cloudflare solution to make matches via codes but its a **WebRTC data channel** connecting two players directly.

replies.author: Acceptable_Movie6712
replies.body: Thanks for looking into it for me! Very cool

replies.author: GTTGgames
replies.body: np its really cool cause the server just makes the handshake thing and then you are sharing the sim of the game that way and isnt simulating   im still learning but ive been learning VIA AI ..something that isnt talked about enuf

comments.author: jupanaes2
comments.body: How did you manage the multiplayer side? Do you have a server or one player works as the server? What stack are you using?

replies.author: GTTGgames
replies.body: I have a server now and it can handle 10k players a day? I think ..ha so im good

replies.author: GTTGgames
replies.body: well actually im just using the server in a diff way - just for the hand off of matches/codes - here's sonnet : Multiplayer is peer-to-peer, not client-server — there's no game server hosting matches. Under the hood it's **delay-based lockstep**: both players' games run the exact same deterministic simulation. **WebRTC data channel** connecting the two players directly.
